title: Junior Technical Officer, Law Officer and More     – 13 Posts
age_limit: The listed age limit is normal for EWS/UR; relaxed by 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC, and 10 years for PwBD, in respect of vacancies reserved for them || Ex-Servicemen/Commissioned Officers: 5 years' relaxation (subject to at least 6 months' continuous service after attestation as on the closing date) || Central/UT Government servants: up to 5 years (10 years for SC/ST, 8 years for OBC posts reserved for them), subject to 3 years' continuous service in an allied cadre || PwBD candidates: 10 years' relaxation (so SC/ST-PwBD get up to 15 years total, OBC-PwBD up to 13 years total), subject to maximum age on closing date not exceeding 56 years; disability must be 40% or more
selection_process: Selection is by interview, or by a Recruitment Test (RT)/Combined Recruitment Test (CRT) followed by interview, depending on the number of applications received for a post. There is no fixed CBT syllabus published for these posts in the advertisement. || Where applications are numerous, UPSC may apply shortlisting criteria: higher desirable qualifications, higher-than-minimum educational qualification, higher-than-minimum relevant experience, experience before/after acquiring essential qualification, experience not otherwise prescribed, or a Recruitment Test || Minimum level of suitability at interview (out of 100 marks): UR–50, OBC–45, SC/ST/PH–40 || Where an RT precedes the interview, candidates must clear the minimum suitability level at both stages; the RT qualifying level is decided case-by-case by UPSC || Where an RT/CRT is held, it will ordinarily be conducted at: Ahmedabad, Bhopal, Chennai, Delhi, Dispur (Guwahati), Jaipur, Jammu, Kochi, Kolkata, Lucknow, Mumbai, Nagpur, Port Blair, Ranchi, and Visakhapatnam (Leh/Kargil/Srinagar/Delhi for Ladakh UT posts) || Candidature is provisional at every stage; mere fulfilment of minimum qualification/experience does not guarantee a call for interview || Where sufficient eligible PwBD candidates are not available for exclusively-reserved posts, the experience requirement (years, not nature) may be relaxed up to 50%

title: Engineering Services Examination, 2027 (ESE 2027)     – 480 Posts
qualification: For admission to the examination, a candidate must have: || Obtained a degree in Engineering from a University incorporated by an Act of the Central or State Legislature in India, or another educational institution established by an Act of Parliament or deemed a University under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956; OR || Passed Sections A and B of the Institution Examinations of the Institution of Engineers (India); OR || Obtained a degree/diploma in Engineering from a recognised foreign University/College/Institution; OR || Passed the Graduate Membership Examination of the Institution of Electronics and Telecommunication Engineers (India); OR || Passed the Associate Membership Examination Parts II and III/Sections A and B of the Aeronautical Society of India; OR || Passed the Graduate Membership Examination of the Institution of Electronics and Radio Engineers, London (held after November 1959). || For the posts of Indian Naval Armament Service (Electronics Engineering) and Indian Radio Regulatory Service Group 'A', an M.Sc. degree or equivalent with Wireless Communication Electronics, Radio Physics, or Radio Engineering as a special subject is also accepted, as specified in the notification. || Important note: Following a Delhi High Court judgment dated 13.01.2023, degrees/certificates from the Institution of Electronics and Telecommunication Engineers (India) and the Aeronautical Society of India obtained after admission post 31.05.2013 will NOT be admissible for ESE 2027. Eligibility of candidates with a degree/certificate from the Institution of Engineers (India), admitted after 31.05.2013, is subject to a pending Government decision following a separate Delhi High Court judgment.
age_limit: A candidate must have attained the age of 21 years and must not have attained the age of 30 years on 01.01.2027 - i.e., born not earlier than 02.01.1997 and not later than 01.01.2006. || Candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC who also fall under Ex-Servicemen or PwBD categories are eligible for cumulative relaxation under both categories. Once a candidate selects General/Reserved category at the time of application, subsequent requests to change category will not be entertained by the Commission. || Also Read: UPSC CGSE 2027 Notification Out - Combined Geo-Scientist Preliminary Exam for 127 Posts
application_fee: Candidates (except Female/SC/ST/PwBD, who are exempted from fee payment) are required to pay a fee of ₹200 (Rupees Two Hundred only), payable through net banking of any bank, or by Visa/Master/RuPay Credit/Debit Card/UPI. Payment through any other mode is not valid or acceptable, and applications submitted without the prescribed fee (unless fee remission is claimed) will be summarily rejected. Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances, nor can it be adjusted against any other examination. No fee exemption is available to OBC/EWS candidates - they must pay the fee in full.

title: Post Name
qualification: LLB, DNB, PG Diploma, M.Phil/Ph.D, MS/MD
application_fee: Fee payable: ₹25 (Rupees Twenty-Five only), via Visa/MasterCard/RuPay Credit/Debit Card/UPI or internet banking. || Women candidates, and candidates belonging to SC, ST or Persons with Benchmark Disability (PwBD) of any community, are exempted from fee payment. || No fee exemption is available to OBC/EWS/Unreserved male candidates - they must pay the full fee. || Applications without the prescribed fee will be summarily rejected, with no representation entertained. || Fee once paid is non-refundable and cannot be adjusted against any other examination/selection.
selection_process: Recruitment is "by Selection" - primarily interview-based. Mere possession of the essential qualification does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview. || Where the number of applications is large, UPSC may apply shortlisting criteria: Desirable Qualifications, higher educational qualification, higher/relevant experience, or by holding a Recruitment Test (RT). || Minimum level of suitability in interview (out of 100 marks): UR – 50 marks, OBC – 45 marks, SC/ST/PH – 40 marks. || Where a Recruitment Test (RT) precedes the interview, candidates must clear the minimum suitability level at both the RT and interview stages. || Recruitment Test/Combined Recruitment Test (if held) will ordinarily be conducted at: Ahmedabad, Bhopal, Chennai, Delhi, Dispur (Guwahati), Jaipur, Jammu, Kochi, Kolkata, Lucknow, Mumbai, Nagpur, Port Blair, Ranchi, and Visakhapatnam (for the Ladakh post: Leh, Kargil, Srinagar, and Delhi). || Shortlisted candidates must send self-attested copies of documents/certificates as and when demanded by the Commission. || Summoning for interview does not guarantee selection. Appointment orders are issued by the Government after final selection. || UPSC may grant higher initial pay to candidates adjudged meritorious in the interview.
